RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly assign a number from these facts.

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence that sex influenced the decision. Neither is the successful candidate’s sex.

Your qualifications make your disappointment understandable, but a higher academic degree doesn’t automatically establish stronger suitability for a leadership role. Regulatory expertise, management experience and interview performance may have mattered; the announcement cannot establish the full comparison.

Follow up on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, your assessment against them and the reasons for preferring the successful candidate.

Raise concerns about sex discrimination if concrete evidence emerges—for example, sex-based remarks or inconsistent treatment—not simply because of the panel’s composition.
